newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1, France 2 audience share rose in Feb -Mediamat.
newsitem.headline: TF1, France 2 audience share rose in Feb -Mediamat.

text.p: French private television station TF1 and public channel France 2 gained audience share in February compared to January, according to monthly figures from Mediamat, the French television audience measurement body.
Despite its month-on-month rise, TF1's share is still below its February 1996 level, according to figures released on Tuesday.
The share of public channel France 3 fell after rising in January, while the shares of private channel M6 and pay TV channel Canal Plus dipped slightly, they showed.
Individuals of four years and over - %

NOTE: The results in brackets are adjusted to take into account the incomplete coverage of M6, Arte and la Cinquieme (91 percent of the population for M6, 88 percent for Arte and La Cinquieme). They also take into account the fact that Arte broadcasts in the evenings only while La Cinquieme broadcasts only during the day on terrestrial channels.
